appearance_facts.fact: Title 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'.
Vertical color legend. Top label 'High' aligned with 100 (pale yellow). Bottom label 'Low' aligned with 0 (dark maroon). Intermediate ticks at 80, 60, 40, 20.
WA is filled dark maroon (Low end of scale). Label 'WA' visible.
TX is filled pale yellow (High end of scale). Label 'TX' visible.
CO is filled light gray (no data). Label 'CO' visible.
Other dark maroon states include MN, NY, GA, OK, NE, FL. Other pale yellow states include MT, ND, SD, WY, UT, IL, OH, WV, VA, NC, SC, MA, RI.

printed_facts.fact: Scale runs from 0 (Low, dark red) to 100 (High, pale yellow). Ticks: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100.
State abbreviations printed on each state polygon.

public_definitions: Task: open the state incidence profile that should be routed into the highest-incidence follow-up workflow.
uncertain: CO is gray, indicating no data; it cannot be the highest-incidence state.
WA is dark maroon (Low); it cannot be the highest-incidence state.
TX is pale yellow (High); among the three options, it is the only one in the high-incidence color band.
